Let me try to build the fuzzer to test my PoC locally. First, let me check what build tools are available in the build environment.

<｜｜DSML｜｜unction=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜unction=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'which cmake g++ clang++ 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; ls /gt/_work/src/build 2>/dev/null || echo "no build dir"'</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜unction>
